newsitem.title: USA: Superior offers to buy Pac Rim.
newsitem.headline: Superior offers to buy Pac Rim.

text.p: Superior National Insurance Group Inc said it offered to buy Pac Rim Holdings Corp for about $54 million in cash, including about $3.00 per share for the common shareholders.

Terms of the proposed deal were presented to Pacific Rim over the weekend. If approved by Pacific Rim's board, consummation of the deal would be subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and would likely occur early in 1997.
Superior said the offer followed weeks of talks.
"We anticipate that Pacific Rim's Board of Directors will view our proposal favorably and that any remaining issues can be resolved quickly," said chief executive William Gentz.
